## FEATURE 1: UPI PAYMENTS - Lightning-Fast Money Transfers

**About the Feature:**
SUPER PAY's UPI payment infrastructure delivers instant money transfers with advanced QR scanning that works in under 1 second, smart contact integration, and one-tap confirmations. The system combines speed, security, and simplicity to make every payment effortless, whether you're paying merchants, friends, or requesting money from groups.

### Sub-Feature 1.1: Scan & Pay (QR Code Scanner)

**Functions:**
1. **Instant QR Recognition** - Advanced scanner recognizes QR codes in under 1 second even in low light conditions, automatically identifies merchant details with logo display, and suggests payment amounts based on merchant type
2. **Smart Merchant Detection** - Auto-saves frequently scanned merchants for quicker future transactions, maintains merchant-wise payment history for expense tracking, and displays merchant category for auto-categorization
3. **One-Tap Confirmation** - Single tap completes payment after scanning with biometric or PIN authentication, instant payment receipt generation with merchant logo and details, and transaction success confirmation in 2 seconds
4. **Universal QR Support** - Works with all UPI QR codes including merchant static QR, personal dynamic QR, and Bharat QR, supports international QR standards for overseas payments
5. **Payment History Integration** - Auto-categorizes all QR payments by merchant type (food, shopping, transport), maintains detailed transaction history with merchant names and locations, enables expense analysis by QR payment category

### Sub-Feature 1.2: Pay to UPI ID

**Functions:**
1. **Smart Contact Integration** - Phonebook automatically becomes payment book with UPI ID detection, recent recipients appear for instant access to last 10 people paid, contact syncing ensures updated payment details
2. **Multiple Payment Methods** - Send money using UPI ID, phone number linked to UPI, or bank account number with IFSC, supports virtual payment addresses and custom UPI handles
3. **Split Bill Feature** - Automatically calculate split amounts for group expenses, send payment requests to multiple people with custom amounts, track who paid and who's pending in real-time
4. **Payment Scheduling** - Schedule payments for future dates including bill due dates and rent, set recurring payments for monthly obligations like subscriptions and EMIs, auto-reminder before scheduled payment execution
5. **Voice-to-Pay Integration** - Say contact name and amount for hands-free payment initiation, voice confirmation for secure transaction approval, multi-language voice command support for regional users

### Sub-Feature 1.3: UPI QR Code Generation

**Functions:**
1. **Instant QR Creation** - Generate personal UPI QR code in 0.5 seconds with name and UPI ID embedded, support for business QR with company name and GST details, high-resolution QR suitable for printing
2. **Dynamic Amount QR** - Create QR codes with pre-filled amounts for specific purposes like rent collection or product pricing, expiry-based QR for time-limited payment requests, one-time use QR for single transaction security
3. **Multiple QR Support** - Create separate QR codes for different purposes (business, personal, rent, donations), maintain multiple active QR codes with different settings, categorize received payments by QR source
4. **Download & Share Options** - Download QR in multiple formats (PNG, PDF, SVG), share via WhatsApp, email, or social media directly, print-ready format with border and instructions
5. **Payment Tracking** - Track all payments received via each QR code separately, detailed analytics showing payment patterns and peak times, export QR payment history for accounting and tax purposes

### Sub-Feature 1.4: UPI Collect Request

# SUPER PAY - Features Document
## The Ultimate All-in-One Financial Super App

---

## FEATURE 1: PAY NOW - Instant Payment Solutions

**About the Feature:**
SUPER PAY's payment infrastructure is built for speed, security, and simplicity, making money transfers instantaneous with zero hassle. Every payment feature is designed to ensure your money moves faster with bank-grade security, whether you're paying at a store, sending money to friends, or managing your digital wallet.

### Sub-Feature 1.1: UPI Payments

**Functions:**
1. **Scan & Pay (QR Code Scanner)** - Advanced QR scanner recognizes codes in under 1 second with automatic merchant detection, one-tap confirmation, and auto-saves frequently scanned merchants for future quick access
2. **Pay to UPI ID** - Send money using UPI ID, phone number, or account number with smart contact integration, voice-to-pay capability, and split bill features for group expenses
3. **UPI QR Code Generation** - Generate personal or business QR codes instantly in 0.5 seconds with dynamic amount options, high-resolution download for printing, and separate tracking for all QR-received payments
4. **UPI Collect Request** - Send payment requests to multiple people with automatic reminders, deadline settings, real-time tracking of who paid or pending, and batch request capability for group expenses
5. **Transaction Management** - Real-time balance display with show/hide toggle, comprehensive transaction history with advanced search and filters, instant payment receipts, and automatic retry mechanism for failed transactions

### Sub-Feature 1.2: Bank Transfer (NEFT/RTGS/IMPS)

**Functions:**
1. **Smart Mode Selection** - App automatically suggests the best transfer mode based on amount and time, with IMPS for instant 24/7 transfers up to ₹5 lakh, NEFT for 2-4 hours working hours transfers, and RTGS for instant ₹2 lakh+ transfers
2. **Beneficiary Intelligence** - System learns frequent transfers and auto-suggests details, allows saving unlimited beneficiaries with custom nicknames, and enables batch transfers to pay multiple beneficiaries simultaneously
3. **Self Transfer** - One-tap transfers between your own bank accounts in 2 seconds with real-time balance sync across all linked accounts and smart suggestions based on bill due dates and low balance alerts
4. **Zero Transaction Charges** - Completely free IMPS and NEFT transfers with instant success confirmation via UTR number and automatic retry with alternate modes on failure
5. **Account Management** - Add and verify multiple bank accounts, schedule recurring transfers for rent or EMIs, set transfer limits and daily caps, and receive transaction confirmation via SMS and email

### Sub-Feature 1.3: Credit UPI

**Functions:**
1. **Instant Credit Approval** - Pre-approved credit line from ₹5,000 to ₹2,00,000 approved in 60 seconds based on credit score and profile, with 15-45 days interest-free period and zero collateral requirement
2. **Seamless UPI Integration** - Use credit line at any UPI merchant with the same UPI flow, just select "Credit UPI" as source with real-time available credit display and smart purchase categorization
3. **Flexible Repayment Options** - Pay full amount, partial payment, or convert to EMI anytime with auto-debit setup, 5-day grace period before late fees, and smart payment reminders 3 days and 1 day before due date
4. **Credit Building Tool** - Build credit score with every timely payment, lower interest rates than credit cards, and no paperwork or loan applications required for emergency funds
5. **Smart Tracking** - Auto-EMI conversion for large purchases, detailed credit utilization tracking, comprehensive statement generation, and separate categorization of all credit UPI purchases

### Sub-Feature 1.4: Cash Park (Auto-Sweep Savings)

**Functions:**
1. **Automatic Sweep Engine** - Intelligent system detects when wallet balance exceeds set threshold (e.g., ₹10,000) and automatically sweeps excess to FD within 10 seconds earning 7.25% p.a. interest with zero manual effort
2. **Multiple Savings Jars** - Create unlimited custom jars for different goals like Emergency Fund, Vacation, Car Down Payment, or Wedding with visual progress bars, milestone celebrations, and auto-allocation by percentage
3. **Instant Liquidity Magic** - Withdraw money back in 3 seconds without breaking FD, no penalties, 24/7 access to your funds, and sophisticated backend manages liquidity automatically
4. **AI-Powered Recommendations** - App analyzes spending patterns and suggests optimal sweep amounts, automatically selects highest FD rates available, and provides smart TDS management with 80C tax optimization suggestions
5. **Superior Returns** - Earn FD returns (7.25% p.a.) with savings account liquidity, no minimum balance requirements, zero charges for any transaction, and daily interest calculation with monthly credit

### Sub-Feature 1.5: Mobile & DTH Recharge

**Functions:**
1. **Smart Plan Recommendations** - AI recommends mobile plans based on usage history, price alerts notify when favorite plans get cheaper, validity reminders prevent number expiry, and auto-recharge setup for set-and-forget convenience
2. **Comprehensive Operator Support** - All mobile operators supported (Airtel, Jio, Vi, BSNL) with side-by-side plan comparison in one screen, exclusive 2-5% cashback on every recharge, and instant recharge completion under 10 seconds
3. **DTH Intelligence** - View current DTH pack and expiry date, receive channel recommendations based on viewing history, discover combo mobile+DTH offers, and support for all DTH providers (Tata Sky, Airtel Digital TV, Dish TV)
4. **Multi-Number Management** - Save and manage multiple mobile and DTH numbers for family and friends, track complete recharge history, set expiry reminders, and access special family pack offers
5. **Cost Optimization** - Monthly savings of ₹200-500 through smart plan recommendations and consistent cashback rewards, bundle discounts on mobile+DTH combos, and exclusive promotional offers

### Sub-Feature 1.6: FASTag Recharge

**Functions:**
1. **Proactive Balance Management** - Receive low balance alerts when FASTag drops below ₹100, set threshold for automatic recharge, and get instant recharge confirmation via SMS
2. **Multi-Vehicle Support** - Manage FASTag for multiple vehicles including car, bike, and commercial vehicles with separate tracking for each vehicle's toll expenses
3. **Universal Compatibility** - Support for all banks' FASTag services with vehicle number-based search and seamless integration with existing FASTag accounts
4. **Toll Analytics** - View detailed toll transaction history showing where you spent, monthly toll expense analytics with route-wise breakdown, and year-over-year expense comparison
5. **Zero Delay Guarantee** - Never wait at toll plazas due to low balance, automatic recharge ensures continuous toll payments, and complete digital record of all toll transactions

### Sub-Feature 2.4: Municipal Tax & OTT Subscriptions
